mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the stretch receptors was most worthwhile because the result connected a familiar experience—knowing where my arm is with my eyes closed—to signals returning from muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the visual route to the central nervous system felt predictable, though it helped complete the pathway.

surprise.text: I expected the motor nerves to connect directly to the seeing control system; the feedback showed that they first connected to the arm.

arbitrary.text: That connection order was not obvious to me, but the resulting picture gave it a clear purpose: the nerves branch onto the muscles.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter to see how the guided arm acts and how other body systems support it. The pathways were clear, though several combinations felt predictable.
